feasibility_note: RGR-05 Directed Two-Step Composition pre-materialization FEASIBILITY_PASS; separate RGR-05B Flow investigation remains design infeasible under its frozen sampler budget.
rgr06: RGR-06 confirmatory implementation verified independently, but no materialized benchmark/model training/test/replication executed
underlying_causal_contrast: Intervene on surface s versus relation r in x=G(s,r,eta); preserve relation while changing surface, and break relation with surface matched.
scientific_outcomes: No observed results; all proposed comparisons are methodological.

candidate_methods.title: Inspect AI
candidate_methods.role: Declarative dataset/solver/scorer trace custody and evaluator provenance
design_checks: No external provider or member data
candidate_methods.known_gap: Framework task abstractions do not validate RGR hypotheses by themselves.

candidate_methods.title: LM Evaluation Harness
candidate_methods.role: Compare declarative task configs, adapter plugins, frozen metrics and baseline logging
design_checks: No hidden task auto-discovery from unknown modules
candidate_methods.known_gap: General benchmark metrics may not preserve the RGR confirmatory counterfactual contract.

candidate_methods.title: DoWhy
candidate_methods.role: Compare causal estimands, explicit assumptions and refutation methods with RGR paired interventions
design_checks: No unsupported conclusion from observational correlation
candidate_methods.known_gap: DoWhy causal identification/refuters cannot prove subjective relational meaning or transfer by themselves.

candidate_methods.title: pyvene
candidate_methods.role: Later open-weight internal-state intervention comparators distinct from frozen H-RT1 baseline tests
design_checks: No interpretation as awareness or clinical inference
candidate_methods.known_gap: Interventions on neural representations are not proof of a unique geometry, human psychology or MAIA consciousness.

minimum_negative_controls.name: RELATION_PRESERVED_SURFACE_CHANGED
minimum_negative_controls.requirement: Hold relational rule fixed; vary balanced 16-bit surface assignments under frozen RGR-04 constraints.

minimum_negative_controls.name: RELATION_BROKEN_SURFACE_MATCHED
minimum_negative_controls.requirement: Preserve surface realization and other frozen pair invariants; break the directed two-step relational rule with admitted switch.

minimum_negative_controls.name: SYMBOLIC_NON_GEOMETRIC_BASELINE
minimum_negative_controls.requirement: Compare to declarative structure-mapping or graph reasoning; geometric explanation cannot be presumed.

minimum_negative_controls.name: SPLIT_AND_CODEBOOK_LEAKAGE
minimum_negative_controls.requirement: Prohibit cross-split codebook/exact-tuple reuse under frozen seeds and streams.

minimum_negative_controls.name: FALSE_SUPPORT_RESCUE
minimum_negative_controls.requirement: When a preregistered threshold or negative control fails, preserve the failure; never reinterpret success.

governed_next_step: Independent read-only design review and founder approval to pin exact source releases/licenses only. Actual evaluation needs a different research Work Unit and explicit data/model/sandbox authorization.
